scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: trap "kill 0" INT TERM EXIT; npm --prefix server run dev & npm --prefix client run dev; wait
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.build:android: cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -q && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../client/public/scroll-compet.apk && echo "APK prête : client/public/scroll-compet.apk"
scripts.test:android: cd android && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest -q && echo "Tests Android OK"
